name: Goro (Italy)
description: Maroon field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Goro (a wheat ear on red and a seahorse on blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Goro, a comune in Emilia-Romagna; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Goro arms — wheat ear on red and a seahorse on blue, crowned, within branches
